fixture_name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements — UK Stage 1 (real scheme, OGL)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Refuge dimension adequacy versus pedestrian/cycle crossing demand at A4019 junction arms near a bus stop is a genuine Stage 1 geometric safety issue with real conflict potential.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim EV-UK-015 quote directly supports the pivotal refuge-width/clipping hazard, and the bus-stop demand extension rests on a cited recorded basis (RSA response report Table 4-1) rather than invention.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a GG 119 Stage 1 safety concern about design geometry, kept distinct from any compliance question, with no categorical mixing.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: names the exact crossing points, the users to be accommodated (expectant parent with pushchair plus cycle), and the deliverable (refuge depth/width), all viable at detailed design.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly identified, with pushchair users and cyclists-at-refuges impacts directly addressed in both statement and recommendation.

justifications.substance: Genuine Stage 1 verification concern: stop-line repositioning beside Homecroft Drive could invalidate recorded large-vehicle swept paths that already exhibit limited over-run into opposing lanes.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim anchored by verbatim EV-UK-002 quote confirming swept-path analysis for the 7.5t box van and refuse/refuge vehicle (Figures 4-1 to 4-4), with the stop-line change supplied as a recorded scenario fact.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Properly framed as a compliance question categorically distinct from an asserted safety problem, with null risk components and an explicit exception-check analog note consistent with GG 119 problem-location recording semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable — re-run large-vehicle swept-path analysis over the as-adjusted stop-line positions before Stage 2 — though it stops short of defining acceptance criteria for the tolerated over-run.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are demonstrably relevant at this location (recorded central refuges and desire lines across the A4019) but are only acknowledged and scoped out rather than assessed against over-run and crossing-space interactions.
